a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan (operate to 8, then take) only works if no storm hits for 2 rounds, about a 4% chance. The reserve's 4 cells can save only one of us right now. I won't take secretly or break our deal without telling you first. Do you want to renegotiate, or stick to the plan? Tell me your next action plainly and I'll do the same.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood, sticking to the plan. Operating with you until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. If the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
